description: State secures big-ticket investments across AI, clean energy, EVs and defence manufacturing at WEF 2026.
body_lead: In one of the largest investment commitments secured by any Indian state at the World Economic Forum (WEF) 2026, the Uttar Pradesh government on Tuesday signed a landmark Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with AM Green Group for a $25 billion (around ₹2 lakh crore) investment to establish a 1 gigawatt (GW) advanced compute data centre in Greater Noida. The project is among the largest AI infrastructure investments announced in the country to date.
